title: Research and Teaching Associate (ID 2903)
industry: Other Special Economics Topics (JEL Z), Economics, Economics and Social Sciences
text:
What to expect
Institute Life: You will actively contribute to the Health Economics and Policy Group, a vibrant research group within the Institute for Social Policy, by participating in regular meetings, presenting your work at internal workshops, and engaging in the academic life of the institute
Research: You will collaborate with members of the Health Economics and Policy Group on research projects, contributing to research design, data collection and analysis, and scientific publications.
Writing a dissertation: You will be investigating your research topic and spending a third of your working hours on writing your dissertation.
Teaching: You will support teaching in the Bachelor’s Specialization "Health and Social Policy" through co-teaching activities equivalent to approximately 2-3 contact hours per week.
Supervision: You will contribute to the supervision of Bachelor’s and Master’s theses in collaboration with senior faculty members, supporting approximately 2-4 theses per year.
What you have to offer
Academic degree: You have a diploma/master’s degree in economics, health economics, or in a relevant social science that qualifies you for enrollment in a doctoral program at WU.
Quantitative skills: You have a strong background in quantitative methods and are proficient in at least one leading statistical software package, such as Stata or R.
Research experience: You have prior experience conducting quantitative research.
Qualitative methods: Experience with qualitative research methods is not required but would be considered an asset.
Languages: You have an excellent command of English, both written and spoken. German language skills are not required but would be considered an asset.
Willingness to use multimedia teaching methods: You are prepared to use multimedia teaching and learning formats.
What we offer you
Six weeks of vacation/Extra vacation time
Flexible working hours
Training opportunities
A wide range of benefits, from an in-house medical officer to athletic activities and a meal allowance to a variety of employee discounts
Meaningful work in an open-minded, inclusive, and family-friendly environment
A modern campus with spectacular architecture in the heart of Vienna
Inspiring campus life with over 2,400 employees in research, teaching, and administration and approximately 21,500 students
Excellent accessibility by public transportation
Curious? Visit our website and find out more at www.wu.ac.at/benefits

The minimum monthly gross salary amounts to €2,832.08 (14 times per year). This salary may be adjusted based on job-related prior work experience. In addition, we offer a wide range of attractive social benefits.

Do you want to join the WU team?
Then please submit your application by October 07, 2026 under www.wu.ac.at/jobs (ID 2903).
We are looking forward to hearing from you!

WU is committed to diversity and inclusion and actively encourages applications from people of all backgrounds. We particularly welcome applications from women. Not sure if your profile fully matches our requirements? Apply anyway! In case of equal qualification, female candidates will be given preference. Applicants with disabilities will be supported throughout each stage of the recruitment process. Candidates' qualifications will be assessed in the context of their academic age.
